groups.operation: Compile the entry that includes ares.h.
groups.condition: ares.h moves from the project root to include/ares.h.
groups.capability: The compile command must search include/; the supplied command has only -I..
groups.consequence: The entry cannot compile because ares.h is not found.
groups.equivalence_reason: Singleton: header lookup is a distinct compile operation.

groups.condition: The library target moves from the root to src/lib/.
groups.capability: The link command must locate the archive under src/lib/ instead of $SRC/c-ares/.libs/libcares.a.
groups.consequence: The entry cannot link against the archive.
groups.equivalence_reason: Singleton: archive lookup is distinct from header lookup.

groups.operation: Parse a PTR result using an IPv6 address.
groups.condition: A valid PTR packet is supplied while the entry calls the parser with a fixed IPv4 address and AF_INET.
groups.capability: The entry must supply an IPv6 address, its length, and AF_INET6.
groups.consequence: The IPv6 PTR result path cannot be exercised.
groups.equivalence_reason: Singleton: this concerns PTR call arguments, not A or AAAA TTL capacity.

groups.operation: Parse more than five A answers and write their TTL entries.
groups.condition: A packet contains at least six valid A answers, while the entry supplies a five-element TTL array and count 5.
groups.capability: The A parser call must provide capacity for more than five TTL entries.
groups.consequence: The sixth A TTL write cannot be exercised.
groups.equivalence_reason: Singleton: A and AAAA parsing are distinct target operations.

groups.operation: Parse more than five AAAA answers and write their TTL entries.
groups.condition: A packet contains at least six valid AAAA answers, while the entry supplies a five-element IPv6 TTL array and count 5.
groups.capability: The AAAA parser call must provide capacity for more than five TTL entries.
groups.consequence: The sixth AAAA TTL write cannot be exercised.
groups.equivalence_reason: Singleton: AAAA and A parsing are distinct target operations.
